source.title: PM Modi Launches Meerut Metro, Dedicates Full Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat Corridor

lines.notes: Line 1 operational corridor runs 21.3 km between Meerut South and Modipuram with 12 operational stations (9 elevated, 3 underground: Meerut Central, Bhainsali, Begumpul). 4 stations (Meerut South, Shatabdi Nagar, Begumpul, Modipuram) share tracks and interchange premises with the Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat RRTS. Full corridor length including Modipuram Depot is 23 km (13 total stations). Operated by National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC). Inaugurated on 2026-02-22.
